newsitem.title: BELGIUM: EU tells Kesko to sell Tuko consumer goods units.
newsitem.headline: EU tells Kesko to sell Tuko consumer goods units.

text.p: The European Commission told Finnish wholesaler and retailer on Wednesday to divest the daily consumer goods business of former rival Tuko after it blocked the merger between the two firms last November.

"The Commission has decided to require the divestment of Tuko's daily consumer goods business, after taking into account the degree of flexibility which is necessary to ensure that this divestment can be effected in an appropriate fashion and within a reasonable time framework," the Commission said in a statement.
The Commission said its decision must restore effective competition on the Finnish market for retail and cash and carry sales of such goods.

"The Commission's decision provides for the appointment of an independent trustee who will ensure that this order is fully complied with and that the purchaser will possess the necessary skills and resources to ensure that the divested business constitutes an active competitive force on the Finnish daily consumer goods market," it said without giving further details. -- Brussels Newsroom 32 2 287 6800
